name: type a prompt, get an image, tagged with its style
looks: A short headline types on, then a search-style prompt bar below it fills in with a two-word phrase and a round arrow button presses down. Just under the bar a generated photo pops into frame sharpening from a soft blur, with a small rounded chip underneath naming the style used, and a tiny matching icon drops in beside it a beat later.
build: kit.typeOn for the headline and the prompt text at different rates; submit button scale 1 -> 0.88 -> 1 on power3.out; result image scale 0.92 -> 1, filter blur(6px) -> blur(0) over ~0.25s; style chip and icon fade/slide up 4-6px right after.
sound: A soft key tick per character, a click on submit, and a light pop as the image resolves.
prompt: Type a short two or three word phrase into a minimal prompt bar, press submit, and let a generated result sharpen into view from a soft blur just below it, with a small chip naming the exact style or mode it used. Keep the phrase and the result generic and brand-neutral.
